strings.name: Kenneth Roth
strings.summary: Roth moved from legal and prosecutorial work into human-rights organizations, leading Human Rights Watch from 1993 to 2022 and advancing investigations of war crimes, state violence and rights abuses. He continued teaching, writing and advocacy, publishing Righting Wrongs in 2025. His criticism of Israel and other governments drew debate; Harvard’s withdrawal and restoration of a fellowship became an academic-freedom issue.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Long led Human Rights Watch, advancing investigations of war crimes, state violence and rights abuses and international public accountability.

strings.highlights.h2.title: Public accountability
strings.highlights.h2.text: Combined investigations, diplomacy and public advocacy to press governments for accountability, continuing through teaching and books.
